entities.name: Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Information element that informs the UE about S-NSSAIs that were previously in allowed or pending NSSAI but are now rejected by the network.

entities.name: UE support for Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Condition that the UE must support Extended rejected NSSAI capability for the network to include this IE.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information that can be included in rejected NSSAI.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information that was previously allowed for the UE.

entities.name: Pending NSSAI
entities.description: Network Slice Selection Assistance Information that was previously pending for the UE.

relations.description: Network may include Extended rejected NSSAI IE only if UE supports it.
Extended rejected NSSAI contains one or more S-NSSAIs.
S-NSSAIs in Extended rejected NSSAI were previously in allowed NSSAI.
S-NSSAIs in Extended rejected NSSAI were previously in pending NSSAI.
